posts.title: Shipping a Rust game on 8 platforms in 55 days
posts.description: Loot Hole began as a small WebGPU page and launched on Steam 55 days later as a Rust game that runs in the browser, on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, Meta Quest and PC VR. The phone measurements behind each switch, the byte-exact world that co-op and saves depend on, and the AI tooling that made it possible for one person.
